Time Limit for Order Confirmation

An order should be answered within 30 seconds. Approval or cancellation of the order is considered as an answer. If an order is not answered in 30 seconds, restaurant is called automatically by IVR.

If the restaurant is not closed, the restaurant that reaches the confirmation time limit will automatically be closed. and orders will be canceled. Confirmation time limit is 5 minutes.

If the POS company approves the order by using the panel before querying it with /food-orders/periodic/unapproved, the order can be queried with /food-orders/active endpoint.
